children: QNB Corp. executed a strategic repositioning of $254.4 million of available-for-sale securities, taking an estimated $26.2 million pre-tax loss while targeting a blended yield of 5.45%.
Sold $254.4M in AFS securities (weighted-average yield 1.59%) to reposition roughly 46.8% of the securities portfolio.
Unwound $162.0M notional of pay-fixed swaps as part of the repositioning.
Estimated net pre-tax loss of $26.2M to be reported in Q3 2026; expected to be recovered in under four years.
Net proceeds to buy higher-yield, low-risk AFS securities and fund loan growth with expected blended yield ~5.45%.
Transaction had no immediate impact on shareholders’ equity or book value per share; capital levels remain above regulatory well-capitalized thresholds.
